title: Architektura Skalowania: Jak $ETH i @ethereum budują warstwy przyszłości? 🏗️📜
subTitle:
Wielu widzi w Ethereum tylko token, ale prawdziwa rewolucja to jego rola jako Warstwy 1 (L1) – fundamentu, na którym wyrasta cała gospodarka Web3. Skalowanie nie odbywa się na Ethereum, ale dzięki niemu.
Wprowadzenie
@Ethereum_official  rozwiązuje problem trylematu blockchaina, stawiając na decentralizację i bezpieczeństwo, a skalowalność delegując do Warstwy 2 (L2). To fundament, który pozwala innym budować szybciej i taniej.
Technologia
Jako L1, @undefined przetwarza i finalizuje transakcje z L2 (jak Polygon, Arbitrum, Optimism). Działa to na zasadzie "dowodów" (np. ZK-Rollups), które są zapisywane na głównym łańcuchu, gwarantując bezpieczeństwo bez zapychania sieci.

Rola tokena
$ETH jest paliwem (Gas) niezbędnym do zabezpieczania sieci (Staking) oraz do finalizacji wszystkich transakcji z L2. Bez $ETH, struktura L2 nie miałaby fundamentu bezpieczeństwa.
Ważny fakt
Dzięki aktualizacjom takim jak "The Merge" i nadchodzącym "Proto-Danksharding", @undefined drastycznie obniża koszty zapisu danych dla L2, co czyni cały ekosystem bardziej efektywnym.
Podsumowanie
Zalety: Najbezpieczniejszy i najbardziej zdecentralizowany fundament dla smart kontraktów.
Ryzyka: Wysokie opłaty na L1 w okresach hossy (co jednak napędza adopcję L2) oraz konkurencja ze strony innych L1.
#ETH #Blockchain #Layer2 #CryptoEdukacja  #Techanalysis

translatedData.title: Scaling Architecture: How $ETH and @ethereum are building the layers of the future? 🏗️📜
translatedData.subTitle:
Many see Ethereum only as a token, but the true revolution is its role as Layer 1 (L1) – the foundation on which the entire Web3 economy grows. Scaling does not happen on Ethereum, but thanks to it.
Introduction
@Ethereum_official  solves the blockchain trilemma by prioritizing decentralization and security, while delegating scalability to Layer 2 (L2). It's the foundation that allows others to build faster and cheaper.
Technology
As L1, @undefined  it processes and finalizes transactions with L2 (like Polygon, Arbitrum, Optimism). It works on the basis of "proofs" (e.g., ZK-Rollups), which are recorded on the main chain, ensuring security without clogging the network.

午盘时段，ETH/USDT当前报价2108.78，24h涨0.85%（+17.72），最高2115.95，最低2061.6，成交额达304,129,250 USDT。4H级别趋势明确上行，最新4H K线开盘2096.15，高点2115.95，低点2096.13，收盘2108.78，形成强势阳线，近期波动幅度39.75。

盘面概述：K线走势向上，价格稳居均线上方，绿色均线提供有力支撑，红色均线跟随上移，整体多头氛围浓厚。成交量红绿相间，放量与缩量交替，午盘量能有所放大，支持价格上探。

技术分析：图表信号标记清晰，包括‘看涨 OB’和‘看跌 OB’，当前‘看涨 OB’主导，伴随‘强’字提示，显示多头力量占优。指标面板中ATR、WT和EMA状态积极，ATR值反映波动适中，利于日内操作。均线系统排列良好，价格在绿色均线上方运行，避免了下方纠缠。

#tradingview  #麒麟指标  #合约  #ETH  #BTC  
关键价位：支撑位关注2096.13（最新4H低点及均衡区附近），若失守可能回测2061.6日低；压力位2115.95（24h高点及溢价区上沿），突破则看向2120上方。日内走势演变需盯紧这些水平，量能变化是关键信号。

操作思路：午盘多头占优，若量能持续放大，可考虑短线做多，入场2108-2110区间，止损2095下方（风险控制在0.6%以内），首目标2116高点，次目标2125。反之，若缩量滞涨或出现看跌OB强化，及时止盈离场，避免追高。实盘强调风险管理，仓位不超过总资金2%，结合BTC联动观察。日内机会在于量价配合突破，耐心等待确认。

#MarketToday Hoy, 15 de marzo de 2026, el mercado cripto muestra a Bitcoin (BTC) en torno a los 71.200 USD, Ethereum (ETH) cerca de los 2.085 USD, y Binance Coin (BNB) alrededor de los 648 USD. La tendencia general es de ligera corrección tras subidas recientes, con BTC estable, ETH mostrando volatilidad positiva en la semana y BNB manteniéndose en rango.

📊 Resumen de precios y tendencias actuales

| Criptomoneda | Precio actual | Variación 24h | Capitalización de mercado | Tendencia |
|--------------|---------------|---------------|---------------------------|-----------|
| BTC      | ~71.269 USD  | -0.10%  | ~1.40 T USD | Estabilidad con leve corrección |
| ETH      | ~2.085 USD  | -0.51% (día), +5.85% (semana) | ~254 B USD  | Recuperación semanal, ligera caída diaria |
| BNB      | ~648 USD  | +0.31% (día) | ~88 B USD  | Rango lateral, leve alza |

🔎 Análisis rápido
- Bitcoin (BTC):  
  Se mantiene en la zona de los 71 K USD, con soporte fuerte en 70 K. La capitalización supera 1.4 T USD, reflejando confianza institucional. La tendencia semanal es negativa (-3.5%), pero el rango actual indica consolidación.  

- Ethereum (ETH):  
  Cotiza sobre los 2.080 USD, con una subida semanal de +5.8%. El volumen de negociación ha sido alto (23.7 B USD en 24h), lo que sugiere interés renovado. Sin embargo, la caída diaria (-0.5%) muestra resistencia en la zona de 2.100 USD.  

- BNB (Binance Coin):  
  Se mantiene estable en torno a 648 USD, con variaciones mínimas. Su capitalización ronda los 88 B USD y el suministro está totalmente en circulación (136 M BNB). La tendencia es lateral, con soporte en 630 USD y resistencia en 650 USD.  

⚠️ Riesgos y consideraciones
- Alta volatilidad intradía: BTC y ETH muestran movimientos de ±2–3% en cuestión de horas.  
- Resistencia técnica: BTC enfrenta resistencia en 73 K USD y ETH en 2.150 USD.  
- BNB dependiente de Binance: Su desempeño está ligado al ecosistema Binance, lo que implica riesgos regulatorios.  

📌 Conclusión
El mercado hoy refleja consolidación en BTC, fortaleza relativa en ETH y estabilidad en BNB. Para un trader en Panamá, la estrategia más prudente sería observar niveles clave: BTC 70 K–73 K, ETH 2.050–2.150, y BNB 630–650 antes de tomar decisiones de entrada o salida.

I just saw the latest data from ultrasound.money, it's interesting, sharing it with everyone to take a look 👇

Since Ethereum completed the merge (The Merge), the circulating supply of ETH has actually increased by over 1 million coins! The current total supply is about 121.53 million coins.

💡 Key point:
Although it has been said that "ultrasound money", since the merge, Ethereum's annualized inflation rate is about +0.24%. Yes, you read that right, it is currently in a very slight inflation state.

This does not mean that Ethereum is not excellent. Under the PoS mechanism, this inflation rate is already pitifully low compared to the previous PoW's 3-4%. Moreover, the current Gas fees have not taken off yet; once on-chain activities become active again and the Burn mechanism takes effect, it may truly enter a sustained deflationary state.

⚡️ Personal opinion:
The current net increase of 1 million coins seems more like a buildup for the next explosion. Once demand returns, the burning mechanism of EIP-1559 will quickly "stab back", resulting in deflation.

title: 3月15日 BTC/ETH 深度复盘 | $74K被精准狙击后，下一步怎么走
subTitle:
BTC这周走了一波像样的反弹，从$66,500直接干到$73,800，一周12%的涨幅。但$74K这个位置就像装了弹簧一样，碰了就弹回来，现在又回到$71,200附近晃。

到底是反弹结束准备继续跌，还是蓄力再冲？今天把BTC和ETH的盘面拆开来看看。

**BTC：$74K为什么过不去？**

**先看这波反弹是怎么起来的**

2月底BTC跌到$62,000-$64,000的时候，恐惧贪婪指数一度到了5——上一次这个数字还是FTX暴雷。然后鲸鱼开始疯狂接货：3月5日单日积累了66,940枚BTC，有个地址从币安分10天系统性提走了2,003枚BTC（约$1.4亿）。BTC交易所储备直接降到6年新低。

BTC ETF那边也转向了，前五周净流出$38亿的颓势被逆转，最近两周净流入$14.7亿，BlackRock的IBIT三天就吸了$11亿。

机构在抄底，散户在割肉，典型的筹码交换。这波反弹不是随便拉的，背后有真金白银在撑。

**但$74K就是过不去**

$73,800-$75,000这个区间的阻力不是画线画出来的。Glassnode数据显示，期权市场在$75K堆了大量Call，做市商要对冲这些头寸就得在这个价位附近卖出现货——买方越猛，对冲抛压越大。

3月14日BTC冲到$73K以上的时候，全网触发了$2.46亿多头清算加上$8,850万空头回补。很多追多的人直接被高位套住了，这些被清算的多头仓位反过来又加速了价格回落。

经典的冲高、清算多头、加速回落剧本。

**技术面拆解**

日线上，MA5报$71,090，MA10报$70,987，刚形成金叉，价格站在上面，短期结构确实偏多。但MA30在$70,800，价格就贴在这条线上面一点点，说明上涨的推力其实没那么强。

MACD方面，DIF还在零轴上方但红柱已经在缩短了，多头动能在一格一格地衰减。RSI在46-56之间来回晃，既不超买也不超卖，多空谁都不服谁。

布林带正在收窄，上轨$73,900、下轨$68,200，价格在中轨偏上。布林带收窄之后必然迎来一波扩张，问题就是往哪个方向。结合MACD动能衰减来看，如果短期没有增量资金进场，向下破中轨$71,000再探$68,000-$69,000的概率不低。

4小时级别，从$74K下来之后高点在持续降低，形成了一个收敛下降通道。$71,200-$71,500是短期多头最后的防线，反复测试站不稳的话，$70,000大概率还得再去一次。

大周期必须说清楚——去年10月ATH是$126,073，到现在跌了43.5%。3日线级别的Supertrend还压在头上，周线也没翻多。所以从大级别来看，这一波$66K到$74K只是下跌趋势中的反弹。在没站稳$80K之前，不能说趋势反转了。不是唱空，但事实就是事实。做反弹可以，别当反转做。

**BTC关键位梳理**

上方强阻力在$73,800-$75,000，前高加上期权Call密集区加上布林上轨，三重压力叠在一起。再往上$78,900-$80,000是Supertrend压力和心理关口，属于中期阻力。

下方短期支撑看$70,000-$70,800，MA30和整数关口。如果这里守不住，中期支撑在$68,300-$69,800的斐波那契0.382回撤位。$66,100是本轮反弹的起涨点，属于强支撑。极端情况下$60,000-$62,000是期权Put密集区加上2月深跌低点。

现在BTC就夹在布林带上下轨之间，收窄到了一定程度，方向选择就在这一两周。

**ETH：月线六连阴，但鲸鱼在拼命接**

**到底有多弱**

先摆数据。ETH从去年8月$4,955的高点一路阴跌到现在的$2,090，跌了58%，月线收了六根连续阴线。同期BTC跌了43%，ETH的弱势肉眼可见。本周从$1,993起步，最高摸到$2,206，又缩回来了。ETH/BTC的汇率也在持续走低，资金在往BTC集中。

**但链上数据讲了另一个故事**

越跌越有人买，而且是大钱。持仓10K-100K ETH的鲸鱼地址本周增持了54万枚ETH，0x8E3开头的地址3天买了$1.53亿，另一个巨鲸3天扫了63,324枚ETH约$1.31亿。交易所ETH储备降到1,600万枚，多年低位，每天还在以$550万的速度净流出。

衍生品这边，OI升到1,367万枚ETH，1月底以来最高。但资金费率正负交替，说明新开仓位多空都有，市场在等一个方向性的触发因素。

有一点值得单独拿出来说：ETH的ETF还在流出，单日最大流出$8,080万。机构通过ETF在撤，但链上巨鲸在接。这两拨人到底谁对？只有时间能证明。

**技术面**

$2,120是现在的多空分水岭。50日EMA和结构性阻力叠加在这个位置，过去一周反复冲但站不住。分析师Large Petrol在X上说得很直接：1小时图上ETH扫了EXP HIGH流动性区间后直接被打回来，高点在持续降低。

站稳$2,120的话，$2,150-$2,200的空间就打开了，可以确认短期反转。守不住$2,000的话，$1,940甚至$1,900都有可能去到。RSI和MACD目前都在中性区间，没给明确信号。

ETH现在处在一个"巨鲸吸货但散户不买账"的阶段。链上数据偏多，价格结构偏弱，这种矛盾往往意味着在酝酿大波动，但方向还没选出来。如果BTC能站稳$73K以上，ETH可能补涨。但如果BTC先跌了，ETH大概率跌得更狠，这一点要做好心理准备。

**市场情绪和宏观背景**

**恐惧贪婪指数：15-18**

极度恐慌。2月23日暴跌时到过5。这种级别的恐慌从反面来说是好事——真正的底部从来不是在乐观中形成的。但恐慌也可以持续很长时间，2022年FTX之后恐慌了好几个月才见底。

**鲸鱼积累比率：0.64**

9年新高。大资金在系统性建仓。CryptoQuant分析师Axel Adler Jr的数据显示，卖方风险比率降到了本轮周期均值的1/6，抛压基本枯竭。上一次出现这种水平时BTC还在$16,000-$20,000。他的结论是市场从"分发阶段"进入了"积累阶段"。

**资金费率：-0.0023%**

负费率意味着空头在支付资金费。多空比64.8%对35.2%，多头仓位多但空头更坚定。这种结构下如果来一波快速上涨，空头被迫回补会形成逼空。反过来如果继续跌，多头的清算又会加速下跌。弹簧压得很紧，就差一个触发。

**宏观面**

中东局势在恶化，油价飙了60%以上，传统市场避险情绪浓。美元指数创年内新高，对风险资产构成压力。PCE数据出来偏热，降息预期被推迟。

但另一方面，币安研究院今年的展望提到了"全球同步降息加财政刺激加去监管"的三重利好预期。如果后续落地，流动性可能会很猛。短期看宏观是逆风的，但中长期的叙事还没破。关键变量是美联储什么时候真的转向。

**总结**

BTC在$68K-$75K之间横盘整理，$74K是短期天花板，$70K是地板。布林带收窄预示着方向选择临近，这一两周大概率会走出来。链上所有指标都在指向"底部区域"——鲸鱼积累创9年新高、交易所储备创6年新低、抛压降到周期均值的1/6。但价格还没确认，底部信号和底部价格之间有时候隔着好几个月。

ETH更弱，$2,120过不去就别谈反转。鲸鱼在买不代表马上会涨，六根月线阴线的惯性不是一天两天能扭过来的。

现阶段最重要的是耐心。该来的行情不会缺席，但在方向明确之前，保住本金比什么都重要。

In the past 24 hours, the discussion volume of $BTC  has directly crushed the entire market—about 169,000 mentions and 143 million interactions, far exceeding other coins. In second place is $ETH , with about 72,000 mentions in the past day. Although the discussion volume is still nearly half that of BTC, the trend is not weak. Looking further down, the third is $SOL , with a discussion volume of about 44,000; the fourth is $XRP, with about 23,000. Putting these four together, you will find that most of the attention in the cryptocurrency circle has been almost absorbed by them.

🚨币圈注意力回流四大币：当市场不确定时，大家只聊 BTC、ETH、SOL、XRP

今天看了一组社交数据，其实挺有意思，基本把现在的市场情绪讲清楚了。

过去 24 小时里，$BTC  的讨论量直接碾压整个市场——大约 16.9 万次提及、1.43 亿互动量，远高于其他币。更夸张的是，比特币的社交主导度比上周 飙升了 200%+，说明整个加密社区的注意力正在重新集中到 BTC 身上。

背后原因也不复杂。首先是 Strategy 刚刚完成史上最大规模单日买入，一口气加仓 4000 多枚 BTC；其次，美国参议院通过法案，将 CBDC 禁令延长到 2030 年；再加上中东局势紧张，很多资金开始寻找避险资产。结果就是，比特币不仅跑赢山寨，甚至连美股和黄金都被压了一头。

排在第二的是 $ETH ，过去一天约 7.2 万次提及。虽然讨论量仍比 BTC 少接近一半，但走势并不弱。有个细节很多人没注意：这周 ETH ETF 的资金流入已经开始超过 BTC ETF。简单理解就是，市场分工越来越清晰——BTC 偏避险，ETH 更像进攻资产。

再往下看，第三是 $SOL ，讨论量约 4.4 万；第四是 $XRP，约 2.3 万。把这四个放一起就会发现：整个币圈的大部分注意力几乎都被它们吸走了。

反过来看长尾币种就有点惨。像 $DOGE、$PUMP、$USDC、$ADA、$TAO、$TRUMP 这些，最近的社交讨论量都在下降。换句话说，市场关注度正在从“到处开花”，变成“高度集中”。

这其实是典型的周期现象。宏观环境越不确定，叙事就越收缩，人们不再研究第 200 个新故事，而是把注意力放回最确定、最熟悉的资产上。

所以现在的市场可以用一句话总结：资金和注意力正在往“质量曲线”的上端移动。当风开始变大时，大家都会往那几艘最大的船上挤。#加密货币 #BTC #ETH #solana

title: Cryptocurrency scams are expected to reach $12 billion in 2025
subTitle:
According to Chainalysis, cryptocurrency wallets linked to scams generated an estimated $9.9 billion in 2024, and the figure could rise to $12.4 billion as more data becomes available
Crypto-related fraud has grown by an average of 24% annually since 2020, highlighting the increasing sophistication of cybercriminals.
One of the most prominent schemes is the “pig butchering” romance scam, where criminals build relationships with victims through social media or dating apps before luring them into fake investment opportunities.
Revenue from this type of scam increased by nearly 40% in 2024, while the total losses suffered by victims surged by 210%.
Large-scale scam operations are believed to be concentrated mainly in Southeast Asia, with networks becoming increasingly decentralized Many individuals involved in these operations are reportedly trafficked victims who are forced to participate in online scams.
The report also highlights the role of online black markets, such as Huione Guarantee, which provide tools, data, and money-laundering services for cybercriminals.  2021, the platform has processed approximately $70 billion in cryptocurrency transactions.
Notably, revenue from AI-powered scam services on the platform surged by 1,900% in 2024.  warns that the combination of AI and cybercrime is making crypto scams increasingly scalable and far more difficult to detect.

translatedData.content:
I just came across a piece of news that the privacy project in the Solana ecosystem has delayed its mainnet launch again, saying that the audit has not passed.

The comments section is filled with wails, with someone saying, "Is the privacy track toxic? Whoever touches it gets delayed." I glanced at my holding of $NIGHT  and felt a jolt in my heart—could they be talking about me?

Speaking of @MidnightNetwork , I was actually drawn in by its idea of "interaction equals privacy."

It's not the kind that wants to hide everything so drastically, but rather that on-chain data is public, and only the parts that need privacy protection are encrypted using zero-knowledge proofs.

When I saw this at the time, I thought: there’s something there. After all, a fully anonymous chain would be awkward once regulation comes in; this kind of compromise could at least survive.

Then I started researching its Compact language. The official statement says it’s optimized based on Haskell, and the compiler comes with formal verification, allowing vulnerabilities to be squashed in the cradle while writing code.

It sounds much more advanced than Solidity, where you only find out there’s a bug when it runs. I even boasted to a friend: look at their approach, they secure the underlying safety for you first.

Then the question arises.

I flipped through the developer community and found that not many people were discussing Compact. Solidity developers are abundant, and Rust has also become a favorite; who would be willing to learn a completely new language from scratch? I asked a friend who is a developer, and he was quite direct: no matter how good the technology is, if no one uses it, it’s just air. This comment bothered me for several days.

Also, there’s the matter of its deep integration with Cardano. The official statement says it can share the main chain’s computing power and security, which sounds like riding on someone else's coattails. But when I thought about it more deeply: will the interaction between the side chain and the main chain cause bottlenecks? If the side chain collapses, will the main chain suffer as well? Is this kind of dependency leveraging power or setting a time bomb for oneself? #night #ETH #BTC 

I also hesitated about whether to increase my holdings now or wait and see, but ultimately decided to wait until everything the project team mentioned is realized before considering it further.

content:
刚刷到条新闻，Solana生态那个隐私项目又推迟主网了，说是审计还没过。

评论区一片哀嚎，有人说“隐私赛道是不是有毒，谁碰谁延期”。我看了眼自己持仓里那个$NIGHT 的仓位，心里咯噔一下——这说的不会是我吧？

说回@MidnightNetwork 我其实是被它那个“交互即隐私”的思路勾进来的。

它不是那种要把所有东西都藏起来那么极端，而是链上数据公开，只有需要隐私保护的部分才用零知识证明加密。

当时看到这，我心想：有点东西。毕竟全匿名的链，监管一来就尴尬，这种折衷方案起码能活下去。

然后我就开始研究它那个Compact语言。官方说是在Haskell基础上优化的，编译器自带形式化验证，能在写代码的时候就把漏洞摁死在摇篮里。

听起来比Solidity那种跑起来才知道有bug确实高级。我当时还跟朋友吹过：你看人家这思路，底层安全先给你兜住。

那问题来了。

我翻了翻开发者社区，发现讨论Compact的人没几个。Solidity开发者一抓一大把，Rust也成了新宠，谁愿意从头学一门新语言？我问了一个做开发的朋友，他说得挺直接：技术再牛，没人用就是空气。这话让我堵了好几天。

还有它和Cardano深度联动这事。官方说能共享主链的算力和安全，听着像抱大腿。但我细品了一下：侧链和主链之间跨来跨去，会不会卡成狗？万一侧链崩了，主链会不会跟着遭殃？这种依赖关系，是借力还是给自己上了个定时炸弹？#night #ETH #BTC 

我也犹豫过是现在加仓还是再等等看，最终还是决定等项目方说的都落地，在考虑也不迟。

title: 一个成功的交易员的三个必经之路：学➕练➕研
subTitle:
今天想起来之前带技术培训小班课时的趣事…那是一年的春天，线上带了三个宝子学习，但最终发现技术培训确实有点难，有一些完全培训不了的东西，就是人的性格、情绪、天赋、悟道、修心等等这些东西，这些东西有可能不太容易通过外力帮别人改善！
​发现很多时候，我教别人的过程，其实是在劝当年的自己，有点体会到了史铁生说的那句话：“十几岁时，不经意间射出的那颗子弹，十几年后，正中了我的眉心。我想告诉他，我的来时路，让他少走弯路，可惜他却听不懂，我们没办法同时拥有青春和对青春的感受。我想叫醒他，把当年自己不懂的道理说给他听，可当年的我听不进去，现在的他也听不懂。”
所以，​交易这条路有个好的领路人但最终只能通过自己走通，我能做的只是把走通这条路的最核心最必要的知识经验如实告知，有条件的情况下带着训练、复盘和研究…
往后呢，我会在我这个账号的帖子里多多分享干货，宝子们能看懂多少就带走多少啊！#交易训练 #交易心理 #BTC #ETH

translatedData.title: Three Essential Paths of a Successful Trader: Learn + Practice + Research
translatedData.subTitle:
Today I remembered the fun moments from when I led a small technical training class... It was a spring of a certain year, and I was online with three students, but ultimately realized that technical training can indeed be a bit challenging. There are some things that cannot be taught completely, such as personality, emotions, talent, enlightenment, and heart cultivation. These aspects might not be easily improved by external forces!
I've found that many times, the process of teaching others is actually a way of advising my former self. I somewhat understand the words of Shi Tiesheng: 'The bullet that was unintentionally fired in my teenage years struck my brow years later. I want to tell him about my journey so that he takes fewer detours, but unfortunately, he can't understand. We cannot simultaneously possess youth and the understanding of youth. I want to wake him up and share the truths I didn't understand back then, but the me of that time couldn't absorb it, and now he can't understand it either.'

title: Patience Is the Most Underrated Skill in Crypto
subTitle:
When I first entered crypto, I thought the fastest way to make money was simple: trade more.
Every small movement in the market looked like an opportunity. If a coin pumped, I wanted to buy it. If it dumped, I wanted to short it. I was constantly watching charts, trying to catch every move.
But over time I realized something important.
The problem wasn’t the market. The problem was impatience.
In the beginning I used to jump from one trade to another. Sometimes I entered positions without a clear setup, just because I didn’t want to miss a move.
And most of the time, that ended badly.
I also remember moments when I sold too early. A coin would move a little, I would take a small profit, and then a few days later the same coin would make a much bigger move.
This happened more times than I can count.
Over time I started noticing a pattern. The traders who were consistently doing well were not always the ones trading the most. In fact, many of them were doing the opposite.
They were waiting.
They waited for strong setups.
They waited for the right market conditions.
And sometimes they simply stayed out of the market.
Watching the long-term journey of Bitcoin really changed my perspective. It has gone through massive crashes, fear, and countless predictions of failure. Yet every cycle it managed to recover and reach new levels.
The same story can be seen with Ethereum, which faced multiple corrections but continued to grow as one of the most important projects in the crypto space.
That’s when I started understanding something many new traders ignore.
Crypto rewards patience more than speed.
Of course, patience doesn’t mean doing nothing forever. It means waiting for the right moment instead of chasing every move.
Sometimes the best trade is the one you don’t take.
In a market where everyone is trying to move fast and catch quick profits, patience quietly becomes one of the biggest advantages a trader can have.
Just sharing this from my own experience in the market.
Not financial advice.

title: Ethereum Stuck Below $2,100 - And a 2026 Upgrade Could Be the Catalyst the Market Hasn't Priced In
subTitle:
Ethereum has been grinding against the $2.1K level for weeks, and the pattern is hard to ignore. Every approach, every attempted breakout - same result, a rejection.

Key Takeaways
ETH remains capped at the $2.1K resistance level, selling off every time it reaches this pointBulls need to defend the $1.8K support zone or risk further downsideThe Glamsterdam upgrade targets a 78% reduction in gas fees and a jump toward 10,000 TPSScheduled for H1 2026, Glamsterdam could be the catalyst institutions are positioning for early
Crypto analyst Daan Crypto Trades put it plainly this weekend: "Every time price gets to this point, it proceeds to sell off. There seems to be a lot of supply still around this area."
The logic isn't complicated. Heavy resistance zones don't disappear overnight. They get eaten through over time as buyers keep showing up and available supply thins out. Eventually the level breaks - but timing that moment is where most traders get burned.

For now, the more pressing question isn't when ETH clears $2.1K. It's whether it holds $1.8K. That's the support level analysts are watching as the line bulls cannot afford to lose. Drop below it and the structure gets significantly messier. Hold it, and the setup for an eventual breakout above resistance stays intact.
For now, the more pressing question isn't when ETH clears $2.1K. It's whether it holds $1.8K. That's the support level analysts are watching as the line bulls cannot afford to lose. Drop below it and the structure gets significantly messier. Hold it, and the setup for an eventual breakout above resistance stays intact.
The chart isn't telling a bearish story outright. It's telling a patient one. And patience, in this case, may be justified by what's coming on the development side.
 deadline - is the most consequential change to Ethereum in recent memory. The name combines two separate layer updates, and together they go after the two problems that have frustrated Ethereum users the longest: high fees and slow throughput.
On fees, the structural changes being introduced could bring gas costs down by as much as 78%. For anyone who has tried to use an Ethereum-based application during peak network activity, that number is significant. It's the difference between a network that's theoretically useful and one that's actually usable at scale.
On speed, the upgrade introduces parallel transaction processing - meaning the network stops handling transactions one at a time and starts handling many simultaneously. Current throughput on Ethereum's base layer sits around 20 to 30 transactions per second. The post-Glamsterdam target pushes that toward 10,000 TPS on L1 alone. Factor in Layer 2 networks like Arbitrum, Optimism, and Base - which already handle activity off the main chain - and the combined capacity of the ecosystem could reach into the millions of transactions per second.
There's also a deeper architectural shift embedded in this upgrade. A process currently managed by third-party intermediaries - governing how blocks are built and how value is extracted from transaction ordering - gets pulled directly into the Ethereum protocol itself. The outcome is a network that's harder to manipulate, more resistant to the front-running tactics that have long plagued decentralized exchanges, and less dependent on outside infrastructure to function correctly.
Developers are currently in active testing. Three of the core proposals have cleared initial stress tests. The primary risk is complexity - this is a large architectural overhaul, and if compatibility issues between different node clients surface during testing, the H1 2026 window could slip into the second half of the year.
Bottom Line
The short-term picture for ETH is straightforward if unexciting: resistance above, key support below, and a market waiting for a reason to move decisively in either direction.
The medium-term picture is harder to dismiss. A network upgrade that meaningfully cuts costs, dramatically increases capacity, and removes structural vulnerabilities doesn't arrive quietly. Glamsterdam isn't priced in yet - and if it ships on schedule, the conversation around Ethereum's utility at scale changes considerably.
At the time of writing, Ethereum is trading just below the $2,100 level after a 1.7% surge in the past 24 hours.

title: 普通用户参与NIGHT，到底能得到什么？
subTitle:
很多人最近听到 $NIGHT ，第一反应都是：这是不是又一个空投币？拿了就卖？其实如果换个角度看，这个项目给普通用户的东西还真不少，不只是“领空投”这么简单。
先说最直接的好处——早期筹码。
NIGHT来自隐私公链 Midnight Network，这个项目一开始就没有走传统那种VC先拿大量筹码的路线，而是把很多代币通过空投发给普通用户。只要你之前持有过 $BTC 、#ETH 、Cardano、Solana 等主流资产，就有机会分到。
对用户来说，这其实就是一种“早期入场券”。很多老玩家都知道，一个新链刚出来的时候，最值钱的往往就是最早那批筹码。
第二个好处是持币能产生网络资源。
NIGHT有个比较特别的设计：它不是直接当Gas用，而是会生成一种叫 DUST 的资源。简单理解就是，你持有NIGHT，就相当于在“生产网络燃料”。以后在链上转账、交互、用应用，消耗的是DUST。
用大白话讲，就是：拿着NIGHT，本身就像在慢慢攒手续费资源。如果未来这个链用的人多了，这些资源自然也就更有价值。
第三个好处是隐私功能。
现在大多数链，比如 Ethereum 或 Solana，交易基本都是公开的。谁的钱包有多少钱、转给谁，都能查得到。
而Midnight主打的是“可编程隐私”，意思就是有些数据可以选择不公开。比如交易金额、商业信息之类的。对于一些做生意、做项目的人来说，这一点其实挺重要，因为很多时候大家并不希望所有数据都被链上公开。
第四个好处是未来生态的机会。
任何一条新公链刚出来的时候，都会拼命拉用户，比如测试网奖励、生态空投、流动性激励等等。以前不少人就是因为早期参与新链生态，拿到过不少奖励。
如果以后 Midnight Network 上开始出现各种DeFi、游戏或者其他应用，那么最早持有NIGHT的那批人，很可能就是第一批能参与这些机会的人。
所以从普通用户角度来看，#night 给的东西其实挺简单的，可以总结成四点：
第一，早期代币筹码；
第二，持币可以产生网络资源；
第三，隐私交易的可能性；
第四，新生态里的各种机会。
当然，任何新项目都有不确定性。NIGHT未来到底能走多远，关键还是看 @MidnightNetwork 能不能真正做出有用的应用。如果生态发展起来，那早期用户可能会吃到红利；如果生态起不来，那它可能也只是一个短期热点。
但至少现在来看，很多人选择先拿着NIGHT不急着卖，原因其实也很简单——他们在赌这个网络未来可能会长大。

• Relative Strength Index (RSI): This indicator measures the magnitude of recent price changes to evaluate overbought or oversold conditions.

title: What Is Ankr (ANKR)?
subTitle:
Ankr is a decentralized Web3 infrastructure provider that enables developers, applications, and users to interact with multiple blockchain networks more easily. The platform provides APIs and RPC services for building decentralized applications (DApps), staking options through Ankr Earn, and customizable solutions tailored to enterprise-level blockchain needs.
Ankr was founded in 2017 by Chandler Song and Ryan Fang, with a mainnet launch in 2019. The protocol’s native token, ANKR, can be used to pay for services, support node operations through collateral and staking, and participate in governance. ANKR holders can propose and vote on changes to the Ankr Staking system, with approved proposals implemented by the Ankr team to guide the platform’s ongoing development.
What Ankr Provides 
Decentralized node infrastructure services
Setting up a blockchain node requires technical knowledge, time, and effort. Not everyone has the skills to manage node deployment themselves. Ankr simplifies this process by offering access to blockchain infrastructure through a decentralized network of node providers.
This enables developers to interact directly with multiple blockchains, eliminating the need to manage their own infrastructure. These nodes form a global network of independently operated, high-performance machines that can deliver data on demand. With traffic distributed across multiple nodes, applications can benefit from faster response times, improved scalability, and more reliable access to blockchain networks.
APIs and RPC endpoints 
Developers deploying smart contracts and DApps require reliable access to blockchain data. Ankr’s Node API connects you to full and archive nodes using standard RPC and REST requests. Ankr’s Advanced API offers faster, indexed access to historical data and can pull information from multiple blockchains in a single query. These tools enable developers to obtain the necessary data and maintain the operation of their applications without requiring additional backend setup.
Key Features
Scaling services
Ankr’s scaling services provide tools and infrastructure to help blockchains and applications handle higher activity and improve performance. The suite includes Rollup-as-a-Service (RaaS), which provides a ready-made framework for developers to launch their own rollups without needing to build the underlying technology from scratch. Developers can also create sidechains using decentralized infrastructure, with the option to incorporate incentive models, such as liquid staking.
Liquid staking
Liquid staking allows you to stake assets on Proof of Stake (PoS) networks without locking them up. Ankr issues liquid staking tokens (LSTs) that represent your staked assets and the rewards they earn. For example, when you stake ETH through Ankr, you receive ankrETH, a token that reflects both the staked ETH and the rewards it earns over time.
Once you stake a supported asset, the liquid staking tokens are automatically added to your Ankr dashboard. These tokens can still be used for trading or in DeFi applications while they continue earning rewards.
Bitcoin Secured Infrastructure 
Bitcoin Secured Infrastructure (BSI) is a service from Asphere, Ankr’s enterprise arm, that helps developers build custom Layer 1 or Layer 2 networks using Bitcoin’s security as a foundation. BSI provides end-to-end support, including blockchain setup, maintenance, and modular tools that integrate with technologies such as the Cosmos SDK and ZKStack.
Through BSI, teams can work with infrastructure templates that include RPC services, validator setups, and modular components suited for Bitcoin-aligned ecosystems such as Stacks or Babylon. This enables developers to leverage Bitcoin’s security and liquidity while supporting scalability and streamlining certain aspects of the development process.
Enterprise
Ankr’s enterprise offering provides customizable blockchain infrastructure for organizations that require high-performance, large-scale solutions. Businesses can use multi-chain RPC and API services designed for low-latency and high-throughput workloads, backed by dedicated engineering support and the option to request custom configurations.
Additional features include white-label liquid staking and appchains, which cater to enterprises that require flexible staking solutions or their own scalable blockchain networks. Multiple protocols have partnered with Ankr for its enterprise services, including BNB Chain, Chiliz, Polygon, and SushiSwap.
The ANKR Token
ANKR is the native token of the Ankr protocol, with a maximum supply of 10 billion tokens. It’s used within the protocol for multiple purposes, including:
Services: Users can pay for Ankr Network Premium Plans using ANKR, with discounts available for those who opt for this payment method.Collateral: To become a node provider, a collateral deposit in ANKR is required, which helps ensure reliable network performance.Rewards: Node providers can earn ANKR for serving network traffic. Token holders can also stake ANKR with node providers and receive a share of the rewards.Staking: ANKR can be staked to support the network’s distributed node infrastructure, with stakers earning rewards tied to network activity and performance.Governance: ANKR holders can participate in Ankr DAO governance by proposing and voting on network changes. Each token equals one vote, and voting tokens are locked for the duration of the proposal period.

$ETH TREASURY MOVE: Ethereum Foundation Sells 5,000 ETH — What’s Behind It?

The Ethereum Foundation has just executed another major treasury move, selling 5,000 ETH (~$10.2M) to BitMine through an OTC deal. The transaction was completed at an average price of $2,042.96 per ETH, marking the foundation’s second direct OTC sale to a corporate buyer.

This strategy isn’t new. Back in July 2025, the foundation sold 10,000 ETH to SharpLink Gaming at roughly $2,572 per ETH, raising about $25.7M. These sales are part of a broader treasury policy introduced in 2025, where the organization periodically converts a portion of its ETH into fiat to fund operations.

The capital supports protocol research, ecosystem development, and community grants, while the foundation aims to spend about 15% of its treasury annually and maintain a 2.5-year financial runway. At the same time, it’s beginning to stake around 70,000 ETH, adding another layer to its treasury strategy.
